final_text:
Done. Wrote `tests/test_reports.py` with 32 tests covering all six functions:

- **`units_sold`**: no refund, partial, multiple refunds, fully refunded, unknown SKU
- **`sales_by_category`**: kept-units math, status filtering (reserved/cancelled excluded), zero-kept lines omitted, category sorting, half-up rounding, empty input
- **`top_products`**: ranking, tie-break by SKU, fully-refunded exclusion, `n` semantics (0, negative, larger than SKU count, default 3)
- **`inventory_valuation`**: active-only vs `include_inactive`, on-hand (not available), unknown SKUs ignored, rounding, empty
- **`low_stock_report`**: threshold boundary (`<=`), available-vs-on-hand, line format, SKU ordering, inactive products omitted
- **`average_order_value`**: empty → 0.00, status filtering, refund subtraction, denominator, rounding

All 62 tests pass, and a 27-mutation self-check confirmed every injected bug (status-set changes, operator flips, removed rounding/sorting, threshold bound, on_hand/available swap, `n` off-by-one, etc.) kills at least one test. No modules were modified.
